content: Hello—what joint return issue are you dealing with?
My ex underreported income on our joint return. Can I get relief?

You should file **Form 8857** for **Innocent Spouse Relief** under **IRC §6015**. Choose the applicable relief: **innocent spouse**, **separation of liability**, or **equitable relief (6015(f))**. Provide a full statement and documentation.

1) Complete **Form 8857** with facts and timeline.
2) Attach evidence (returns, notices, financials, communications).
3) Mail to the IRS per instructions; keep proof of mailing.
4) The IRS will contact the other spouse; respond to any information requests.

Generally within **2 years** of IRS collection activity for 6015(b)/(c). **Equitable relief** has broader timing—file promptly. Keep transcripts (**Form 4506-T** requests) and all notices in your file.
If approved, your joint liability is **reduced or removed** per the relief type. The IRS will issue a determination letter—retain it with your prior-year return copies.
